name: codex-autoresearch-v2
description: Invocation-only package for remote-first Autoresearch v2.

interface.shortDescription: Invoke generic schema v2 autoresearch runs.
interface.longDescription: Runs schema-v2 targets through configured remote Profiles with isolated workers, metric retention, collection, and optional resource leases. Implementation changes use the separate development skill.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-autoresearch-v2 to inspect or resume an autoresearch run.
Use $codex-autoresearch-v2 to collect the latest autoresearch results.
